requirements: Projection-backed surfaces must visibly expose trust state, last updated time, and stale/degraded reasons.
UI must never present stale operational truth as live truth; page cache cannot substitute runtime truth when trust is insufficient.
Mutating/decision-bearing actions are trust-gated; stale/degraded states permit limited inspection while sensitive actions require refresh or direct runtime revalidation.
Orchestrator must separate active run truth from focused run context and keep a single shared focused run across tabs.
When viewing historical runs, the page must not auto-switch to live activity and must clearly indicate historical mode.
Cross-tab/deep-link/search navigation must preserve or explicitly change focused run identity; never switch run silently.
Run-level history in a project is chronological by default; relationship/lineage between runs must be explicit metadata, not inferred.
decisions: Adopt trust states: current, refreshing, stale, degraded, unavailable.
Use record-backed fallback surfaces (History/Ledger/evidence inspectors) when projection trust is insufficient.
Treat Orchestrator search as object-first and run-aware, distinct from tab-local filtering.
Prefer exact object-identity matches before full-text results in search.
Concern lifecycle remains active/acknowledged/resolved/dismissed, with added lineage and resolution-kind semantics.
data_shapes: orchestrator.project_state.{project_id}: focused_run_id?, focus_mode, last_live_run_id?, selected_tab, per-tab view refs, optional auto_return_to_live=false.
Canonical search result payload: focused_run_id implication, destination tab, selected object id, optional filter payload, optional inspector target.
Concern object split: concern record (durable), concern source event/ref, concern projection (surface rendering).
Minimum concern record fields include IDs/scope refs, category, severity, status, owner/creator refs, timestamps, evidence/source refs, lineage refs, and attention/blocking fields.
Record-semantics vocabulary should distinguish historical vs stale_historical vs superseded vs revoked vs reopened vs archived vs removed.
routing_rules: Unavailable trust routes to canonical record-backed fallback or explicit recover/refresh actions.
Search results route by object type to tab-specific destinations with object preselection and run context handling.
Cross-run result selection explicitly switches focused run and discloses the switch.
verification_rules: Action gating varies by trust state; degraded/unavailable states restrict ambiguous live actions.
Historical lineage must remain visible even when live targets disappear.
Concern dismissal/resolve flows need rationale and lineage-consistent state transitions (merge/split/supersede/invalidate).
owner_consumer_obligations: Concern ownership must be explicit and separable from creator/source/resolver roles.
Concern owner may change over time without changing concern identity.
stale_retirement_items: Retire implicit stale behavior by standardizing trust UI contract across Usage/Orchestrator/Source Control.
Retire silent stale-data presentation patterns in operational tabs.
Retire ad-hoc stale mitigations in favor of uniform trust badges, timestamps, reasons, and gated actions.
open_questions: Finalize exact orchestrator project-state schema and persistence/restore behavior fields.
Define final boundary of historical-safe vs live-only actions per tab (especially Progress).
Define canonical concern event family and storage contracts equivalent in rigor to attempts/blocked/remediation.
Set final run-scope defaults for search (focused run vs project-wide) and disclosure UX.
process_defects: No shared projection freshness schema/contract is currently defined across projection-backed surfaces.
Historical-run mode contract is underspecified, including focused-run persistence semantics.
Canonical cross-feature routing payload is missing across search/deep links/show-in flows.
Concern merge/split/supersession modeling remains discussion-level rather than contract-level.
doc_hints: Align updates with Plans/FinalGUISpec.md safety language and command-palette model.
Coordinate Orchestrator/Run_Graph_View/storage-plan contracts to avoid run-focus drift.
Specify semantic glossary centrally to prevent state-term drift across record families.
